subject: POC scope re-baseline - add NLU extraction use case
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Thompson <jared.thompson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: POC scope: Redwood Inference x AcmeCorp - next steps

Hi Jared,

Thanks again for the time this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC plan in: 

Summary from discovery:
- Primary objective: evaluate Redwood's document ingestion + retrieval pipeline for customer support ticket summarization and routing.
- Key success criteria (initial):
  1) Average latency under 450ms for 1kB prompt with 2k token horizon
  2) F1 >= 0.82 on intent classification test set (500 labeled tickets)
  3) Entity extraction accuracy >= 0.78 on the sample dataset
- Target POC duration: 2 weeks starting Dec 14 (ready-for-infra by Dec 10)
- Owners: Marissa (Redwood) — commercial/coordination; Camila (Redwood CS) — onboarding and eval harness; Jared / Priya (Acme) — data access and infra support

Deliverables and evaluation plan:
- Redwood will deliver an evaluation harness and sample dashboards for metrics by day 3 of the POC.
- Acme to provide a 500-ticket labeled subset, S3 access details, and network allowlist for Redwood infra by Dec 9.
- We will run the test suite (classification + extraction) and provide a report with per-metric thresholds and per-route latency breakdown.

Attachments: Acme_POC_success_criteria_v1.docx (proposal for sign-off).

Please confirm these items and flag any additional use cases you want included — right now we scoped NLU + routing/classification. If you'd like, Camila and I can join a short sync to finalize sign-off.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

From: Jared Thompson <jared.thompson@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC scope: Redwood Inference x AcmeCorp - next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear summary. A few asks/changes from my side after reviewing with the team: 

1) Add an NLU entity extraction use case (customer name, product id, SLA date) as a second wire into the evaluation. This is critical for our downstream routing automation.
2) Can we raise the entity extraction success threshold to 0.82? Our analytics team thinks 0.78 will be noisy for automation.
3) If we add the new use case mid-trial, will that extend the timeline and/or incur extra charges? We prefer to keep the start date Dec 14 but can shift if needed.

I've attached our network_requirements.pdf (firewall rules + proxy) and cc'd Priya (platform) to help with infra.

If adding the extra use case changes resource assumptions materially, can you call that out and propose mitigations (e.g., a one-week extension, reduced dataset size for the initial run, or Redwood providing a pre-filtering step)?

-Jared
Jared Thompson

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 06 Dec 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC scope: Redwood Inference x AcmeCorp - next steps

Hi Jared / Priya,

Thanks — got the network doc and the request to add entity extraction. We can absolutely re-baseline the POC to include the additional NLU extraction use case. Recommended approach below to keep the trial useful while limiting scope creep: 

Updated plan (v2):
- New success criteria:
  • Latency target: median latency < 480ms for 1kB prompt (slightly relaxed given extraction overhead)
  • Intent classification: F1 >= 0.82 on the same 500-ticket test set
  • Entity extraction: F1 >= 0.82 on a focused 250-ticket subset (we'll prioritize examples with clear entities)
- Evaluation approach: run classification + extraction pipelines in parallel; initial extraction run on 250 prioritized tickets to get early signal; follow-up full-run if thresholds are promising.
- Timeline: Start Dec 14 as planned; initial run and baseline report delivered by Dec 21. If the full extraction run is requested, extend the POC one week to Dec 28 (no additional Redwood fees for the one-week extension; this is a one-time accommodation).
- Ownership:
  • Redwood: Camila (technical onboarding + eval harness) and Rachel (SRE coordination)
  • Acme: Jared (product owner), Priya (network/provisioning)

Risks & mitigation:
- Adding extraction increases GPU and postprocessing usage. We'll initially run on the 250-ticket subset to reduce cost and validate signal. If you want the full 500-ticket extraction, we'll schedule a follow-up and confirm any incremental costs.

Next steps / ask:
1) Confirm acceptance of updated success criteria and timeline (reply-all with sign-off).
2) Provide S3 path and temp credentials or a shared folder by Dec 9 so Camila can start wiring the ingestion.
3) Priya: can you confirm the allowlist window (IP ranges) and ETA for firewall changes?

I've attached the updated success criteria doc (Acme_POC_success_criteria_v2.docx) with the changes highlighted and added a HubSpot deal link for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ACME-2026-POC-78

If that looks good I'll schedule the kickoff with Camila and your infra lead next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
